name: visual-production
description: Visual production domain - comics, animation, video production, storyboard design, visual effects, and post-production across all media formats

phase_prompts.research: Research visual style references, target audience demographics, platform specifications.
phase_prompts.decision: Define visual style guide, choose art direction, establish color palette.
phase_prompts.execution: Create visual assets following the storyboard and style guide.
phase_prompts.feedback: Visual quality assessment with diverse perspectives, consistency check.
phase_prompts.delivery: Final render including color grading, format for distribution platform.

quality_gates.name: Visual Consistency
criteria: Art style consistent across all frames
